# Cupie Danny
> A 100-yen Cupie doll that looked just like Danny Rojo from behind — ballpoint tattoos, rainbow whiskers, and a tiny traveler from New York to Cuba.

## Pages
- [Cupie Danny](https://cupiedanny.com/en/): A 100-yen Cupie doll that looked just like Danny Rojo from behind — ballpoint tattoos, rainbow whiskers, and a tiny traveler from New York to Cuba.
- [Gallery — Musicians & Celebrities](https://cupiedanny.com/en/gallery-01/): Cupie Danny photographed with musicians and public figures — José Luis Cortés, Issac Delgado, Alexander Abreu, Lena Burke, Johnny Lozada and more.
- [Gallery — Friends & Family](https://cupiedanny.com/en/gallery-02/): Cupie Danny with family and friends across New York, Cuba, Miami and Japan — Papa Danny Rojo, grandparents, aunts, cousins and friends.
- [Gallery — Adventure](https://cupiedanny.com/en/gallery-03/): Cupie Danny on the road — photographs from Japan, New York, Mexico, Guatemala, Havana and Miami.
- [Theater](https://cupiedanny.com/en/theater/): A small theater with two characters: Cupie Danny, the self-appointed reliable big brother who is always naked, and Shoko-chan, his hermanita.
- [Español](https://cupiedanny.com/es/): Spanish version of the site.
